rationale: pulp create now configures standalone projects with -G Ninja when ninja is on PATH and the build dir is new, as pulp build already does. pulp ship package on macOS now exits 1 when an installer fails or nothing was packaged, where it printed FAILED and exited 0. pulp ship resolves an SDK consumer project (pulp.toml, no core/) as its root and takes ensure_signing_ready.sh and entitlements.plist from the selected SDK's share/pulp/ship, which the install rules now populate. These change generator choice, exit codes and where two existing support files are found. No design-import, Chromium, rendering, packaging-format or signing authority moves: the same installers are built by the same code, and the same preflight script and entitlements are used, from a second location.
